title: 公正敏感性简表（8题）

instructions.en: People react to unfair situations in very different ways. In the following, we would like to know how you would react in unfair situations. Please read the statements below and indicate to what extent each of these statements applies to you. If you have never experienced such a situation yourself, try to imagine how you would react if you were in such a situation.
instructions.zh: 人们面对不公平的情境时，反应很不一样。下面想了解您在这类情境中会如何反应。请阅读各项陈述，选择它们与您相符的程度。如果您从未亲身遇到某种情境，请试着想象自己遇到时会如何反应。

sections.en: First, we will look at situations to the advantage of others and to your own disadvantage.
sections.zh: 首先，请想象对别人有利、对您不利的情境。

sections.en: Now, we will look at situations in which you notice or learn that someone else is being treated unfairly, put at a disadvantage, or used.
sections.zh: 接下来，请想象您发现或得知某个人受到不公平对待、被置于不利地位或被利用的情境。

sections.en: Now, we will look at situations that turn out to your advantage and to the disadvantage of others.
sections.zh: 接下来，请想象结果对您有利、对别人不利的情境。

sections.en: Finally, we look at situations in which you treat someone else unfairly, discriminate against someone or exploit them.
sections.zh: 最后，请想象您不公平地对待、歧视或利用他人的情境。

items.en: It makes me angry when others are undeservingly better off than me.
items.zh: 当别人没有正当理由却比我过得更好时，我会生气。

items.en: It worries me when I have to work hard for things that come easily to others.
items.zh: 当别人轻易就能得到的东西，我却必须付出很大努力时，我会感到困扰。

items.en: I am upset when someone is undeservingly worse off than others.
items.zh: 当有人没有正当理由却比别人处境更差时，我会感到难受。

items.en: It worries me when someone has to work hard for things that come easily to others.
items.zh: 当别人轻易就能得到的东西，有人却必须付出很大努力时，我会感到困扰。

items.en: I feel guilty when I am better off than others for no reason.
items.zh: 当我没有什么理由却比别人过得更好时，我会感到内疚。

items.en: It bothers me when things come easily to me that others have to work hard for.
items.zh: 当别人必须付出很大努力才能得到的东西，我却能轻易得到时，我会感到不安。

items.en: I feel guilty when I enrich myself at the cost of others.
items.zh: 当我以牺牲他人为代价使自己获利时，我会感到内疚。

items.en: It bothers me when I use tricks to achieve something while others have to struggle for it.
items.zh: 当别人必须努力争取的东西，我却靠耍手段得到时，我会感到不安。

scoring.higherMeaning: Stronger reported reactions to injustice from the respective viewpoint; not moral worth or objectively observed conduct

report.heading: 换四个位置，看看您怎样感受公平
report.summary: 同一件事，站在吃亏的人、旁观的人、获益的人或做出行为的人位置上，感受可能不同。这份问卷帮您留意这些差别，不会把四种感受加成一个“人品分”。

perspectives.label: 自己处于不利位置
perspectives.description: 留意自己吃亏时，什么最容易触动您。

perspectives.label: 看到他人受到不公平对待
perspectives.description: 留意看到别人吃亏时，您最在意什么。

perspectives.label: 自己从不公平中获益
perspectives.description: 留意自己无意中占了便宜时，内心会有什么反应。

perspectives.label: 自己造成不公平
perspectives.description: 留意自己的行为影响别人时，您会怎样看待它。

reflection: 最近一次觉得不公平时，您站在哪个位置？
把自己换到另一个位置，会多看到什么信息？
report.action: 找一件日常小事，先写下事实，再写下自己的感受和希望。需要沟通时，可用“发生了什么—我有什么感受—我希望怎样”开头。
report.limits: 回答的是想象或自述的感受，不等于实际行为；不能据此评判自私、善良或道德水平。四视角分开看，不排优劣。中文译本尚待验证。
